articles.title: Patreon Income Tracker: A Monthly Reconciliation Guide
articles.description: Track actual Patreon gross revenue, fees, adjustments, and payouts month by month with a blank, privacy-conscious CSV and a clear reconciliation workflow.

opportunity.decision: The query already reaches the site, and the guide adds an actual-record workflow that the scenario calculator alone does not provide.

sources.title: Payouts Dashboard
claims: The Payouts Documents tab provides earnings, payout, transaction, refund, and tax CSV files.

sources.title: Earnings Insights
claims: The Earnings page is Patreon's record of gross and net income by month.
Patreon's public overview is a trend estimate and is not an accurate record for a specific month.

sources.title: Creator fees overview
claims: Platform, payment processing, currency conversion, taxes on creator fees, and payout transaction fees can affect creator proceeds.
A creator's applicable platform plan depends on the creator's own account history and settings.

sources.title: How to use your Relationship manager
claims: The Relationship Manager can export a filtered member CSV for membership-status reconciliation.
